meta.description: Better Life Moving locations: Boston and Greater Boston, Raleigh and the Triangle, Charlotte, Chicago and Los Angeles, with long distance moves between states.

overview: We started in Brighton, Boston, in 2022 and now run crews in five metro areas. Find your city to see how moves work there.
sellingPoints: Five metros with our own crews
Interstate moves between any of them
One quote form for every location

locationsBlock.intro: Boston is where most of our moves happen, and the Boston crews also cover the nearby cities below. The Triangle, Charlotte, Chicago and Los Angeles each have their own page.
locationsBlock.closing: Don't see your city? If it's on the way between two of our markets, or you're moving out of state, ask for a long distance quote.

servicesBlock.intro: The services below are what we offer. Your city page and your quote confirm what's available for your date.

reviews.heading: Reviews From Customers Across Our Locations

faq.q: Do you move people between Boston and your other cities?
faq.a: Yes. Moves between our markets are long distance moves, quoted at a flat rate and carried by our own trucks.

faq.q: Is the hourly billing the same in every location?
faq.a: The method is the same everywhere: local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Your quote gives the rate for your market.

faq.q: Where is Better Life Moving based?
faq.a: Our head office is at 20 Presentation Rd in Brighton, Boston. The company was founded there in 2022.

faq.q: Do you serve New York, Philadelphia or Washington DC?
faq.a: We move people from Boston to those cities as long distance moves. We don't run local crews based there.

faq.q: How do I check whether you cover my address?
faq.a: Put both addresses in the quote form. The manager who reviews it confirms coverage before anything is booked.

faqClosing: More questions about booking or billing? The FAQ page covers them.

closing.h2: Five Cities, One Way of Moving
closing.body: Same carrier, same billing method, same crews who wrap every piece before it leaves. Send your addresses and we'll price the move.
